label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Paint tab: Move / Paint switch (the user's choice of option 1). The bar opens in Move: one finger moves the map as usual. Paint (or choosing a colour or Erase) makes one finger paint. Two fingers always move the map.

Region tab (renamed from 'Topo map') restored to the 0.1.36 region download: page size or Custom with orientation, region name, map content (LINZ aerial / Satellite / NZ Topo) and detail zoom 13-17, NZ Topo & overlays, area/size/file estimate, Save as PDF and Download, plus folded coordinates. Switches to 2D north-up; 3D comes back when you leave.

Sharp PDFs: the map is stitched from the displayed map's tiles (NZ Topo, LINZ aerial or satellite) at about 200 dpi (NZ Topo capped at z17, satellite z18), four tiles at a time with progress and Cancel; a missing tile uses its parent. The open route is drawn on top. Was a screen capture at about 75 dpi. Overlays drawn by the app (tracks, huts, names on aerial) are not in the PDF; NZ Topo has them printed.

Show stored map detail turns on quickly: cached imagery tiles are recorded as they arrive in a small saved index (native-stored-tiles-v1.bin), so the tint no longer opens every disk-cache entry (about 10 s reported). Saved regions are read from their metadata only, not a size sum over every stored tile. Once per session the index is checked against the cache in the background and the tint refreshes.
